title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively removing some features from the model.

title: Effect of LASSO on Variance
text: Consider how reducing the number of features by setting some coefficients to zero might affect the model's variance. Think about the trade-off between bias and variance.

title: Choosing the Effect on Model Variance
text: What is the possible effect of using LASSO regularization on model variance?
